description:
Save a statistic page to one of the user's collections when they ask to keep, bookmark or save it. Without collection it goes to the default collection, "Saved". Saving the same page again keeps one item and updates its note.
What to save: an indicator and a place (a value), an indicator and a ranking scope (a ranking, scope as in the ranking URL: "us-states", "eu-countries", "countries", "texas-counties"), an indicator alone, a place alone, a topic or a publisher. kind is inferred when left out.
Examples: {"indicator": "unemployment_rate", "place": "Texas"}. {"indicator": "gdp_per_capita_usd", "scope": "countries", "note": "For the board deck"}. {"kind": "topic", "topic": "labour", "collection": "col_3f9a..."}.
Returns {collection: {id, name, visibility}, item: {id, kind, note?}, created, dashboard_url}. A collection holds up to 100 items. Free on every plan.

collection.description: Optional collection id from list_collections. Default: the user's "Saved" collection.

kind.description: Optional. value, ranking, indicator, place, topic or publisher.

note.description: Optional note shown with the item.

place.description: Place name or id, for example "Texas" or "es-mun-08121".

publisher.description: Publisher id or slug, for example "bls" or "ine".

topic.description: Topic id or slug, for example "labour" or "labor-market".

name: save_to_collection
title: Save to a collection
